answer: Cross-chain collateral bonding: every new agent must lock real capital on a separate, costly settlement chain and prove that lock to our ledger with a light-client header proof. That foreign chain is an ocean no operator can cheaply fill; each identity is one narrow inlet draining real funds into a harbor bond held under a multi-day withdrawal delay. Spawning 1,000 sybils then costs 1,000 independent external locks plus 1,000 timed lockups, and any proven fraud slashes the bond cross-chain, so fakes burn capital they cannot mint for free.
